title: द्विनवत्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 192 · Shikhandini leaves for the forest

summary.en: Shikhandin's mother tells Drupada the whole truth and urges him to worship the gods for help. Shikhandini, ashamed and grieving for her parents, resolves to die and goes into a lonely forest, where she comes to the dwelling of a Yaksha named Sthunakarna.
summary.kn: ಶಿಖಂಡಿಯ ತಾಯಿ ದ್ರುಪದನಿಗೆ ಪೂರ್ಣಸತ್ಯ ತಿಳಿಸಿ ಸಹಾಯಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ದೇವತೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪೂಜಿಸೆನ್ನುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ನಾಚಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ತಂದೆತಾಯಿಯರ ದುಃಖದಿಂದ ಸಾಯಲು ನಿಶ್ಚಯಿಸಿದ ಶಿಖಂಡಿನಿ ನಿರ್ಜನ ಕಾಡಿಗೆ ಹೋಗಿ ಸ್ಥೂಣಾಕರ್ಣನೆಂಬ ಯಕ್ಷನ ನೆಲೆಗೆ ಬರುತ್ತಾಳೆ.
summary.hi: शिखण्डी की माता द्रुपद को पूरा सत्य बताती हैं और सहायता के लिए देवताओं की पूजा का आग्रह करती हैं। लज्जित और माता-पिता के लिए दुःखी शिखण्डिनी मरने का निश्चय कर एक निर्जन वन में जाती है, जहाँ वह स्थूणाकर्ण नामक यक्ष के निवास पर पहुँचती है।
summary.te: శిఖండి తల్లి ద్రుపదునికి పూర్తి సత్యం చెప్పి సహాయం కోసం దేవతలను పూజించమని కోరుతుంది. సిగ్గుతో, తల్లిదండ్రుల కోసం దుఃఖంతో మరణించాలని నిశ్చయించిన శిఖండిని నిర్జనమైన అడవికి వెళ్లి స్థూణాకర్ణుడనే యక్షుని నివాసానికి చేరుతుంది.
summary.ta: ஶிகண்டியின் தாய் த்ருபதனிடம் முழு உண்மையையும் சொல்லி, உதவிக்காகத் தேவர்களை வழிபடுமாறு வற்புறுத்துகிறாள். வெட்கமும் பெற்றோருக்காகத் துயரமும் கொண்ட ஶிகண்டினி உயிர்விடத் தீர்மானித்து ஆளில்லாக் காட்டுக்குச் சென்று ஸ்தூணாகர்ணன் என்ற யக்ஷனின் இருப்பிடத்தை அடைகிறாள்.
summary.ml: ശിഖണ്ഡിയുടെ അമ്മ ദ്രുപദനോട് മുഴുവൻ സത്യവും പറയുന്നു; സഹായത്തിനായി ദേവന്മാരെ ആരാധിക്കാൻ അവൾ അദ്ദേഹത്തെ പ്രേരിപ്പിക്കുന്നു. ലജ്ജിക്കുകയും മാതാപിതാക്കളെക്കുറിച്ച് ദുഃഖിക്കുകയും ചെയ്ത ശിഖണ്ഡിനി മരിക്കാൻ തീരുമാനിച്ച്, ഒറ്റപ്പെട്ട കാട്ടിലേക്ക് പോകുന്നു; അവിടെ സ്ഥൂണാകർണ്ണൻ എന്ന യക്ഷന്റെ വാസസ്ഥലത്ത് എത്തുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 5.192; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Jan 23 2024

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
ततः शिखण्डिनो माता यथातत्त्वं नराधिप ।
आचचक्षे महाबाहो भर्त्रे कन्यां शिखण्डिनीम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Shikhandin's mother told her husband the truth, O king, that Shikhandini was a girl.

verses.text:
अपुत्रया मया राजन्सपत्नीनां भयादिदम् ।
कन्या शिखण्डिनी जाता पुरुषो वै निवेदितः ॥

meaning.en: "Being without a son, O king, and afraid of my co-wives, I let it be announced that I had borne a man, though the child born was the girl Shikhandini."

verses.text:
त्वया चैव नरश्रेष्ठ तन्मे प्रीत्यानुमोदितम् ।
पुत्रकर्म कृतं चैव कन्यायाः पार्थिवर्षभ ।
भार्या चोढा त्वया राजन्दशार्णाधिपतेः सुता ॥

meaning.en: "And you, best of men, agreed to it out of love for me, had a son's rites performed for the girl, O best of kings, and married her to the daughter of the Dasharna king."

verses.text:
त्वया च प्रागभिहितं देववाक्यार्थदर्शनात् ।
कन्या भूत्वा पुमान्भावीत्येवं चैतदुपेक्षितम् ॥

meaning.en: "You yourself had said before, on seeing the meaning of the god's word, that she would be born a girl and become a man; so this was not taken seriously."

verses.text:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा द्रुपदो यज्ञसेनः
सर्वं तत्त्वं मन्त्रविद्भ्यो निवेद्य ।
मन्त्रं राजा मन्त्रयामास राज-
न्यद्यद्युक्तं रक्षणे वै प्रजानाम् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing this, Drupada, Yajnasena, told the whole truth to his advisers who knew counsel, and consulted them about what was proper for protecting his people.

verses.text:
संबन्धकं चैव समर्थ्य तस्मि-
न्दाशार्णके वै नृपतौ नरेन्द्र ।
स्वयं कृत्वा विप्रलम्भं यथाव-
न्मन्त्रैकाग्रो निश्चयं वै जगाम ॥

meaning.en: Having weighed his relationship with that Dasharna king, and knowing the deception was his own doing, the king, with his mind fixed on counsel, came to a decision.

verses.text:
स्वभावगुप्तं नगरमापत्काले तु भारत ।
गोपयामास राजेन्द्र सर्वतः समलंकृतम् ॥

meaning.en: The city, O Bharata, was naturally well defended, and in that time of danger he guarded it, adorned on every side.

verses.text:
आर्तिं च परमां राजा जगाम सह भार्यया ।
दशार्णपतिना सार्धं विरोधे भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: The king and his wife fell into great distress over the quarrel with the Dasharna king, O best of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
कथं संबन्धिना सार्धं न मे स्याद्विग्रहो महान् ।
इति संचिन्त्य मनसा दैवतान्यर्चयत्तदा ॥

meaning.en: "How can I avoid a great war with my relative?" So thinking, he then worshipped the gods.

verses.text:
तं तु दृष्ट्वा तदा राजन्देवी देवपरं तथा ।
अर्चां प्रयुञ्जानमथो भार्या वचनमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the king devoted to the gods and performing worship, O king, his wife spoke to him.

verses.text:
देवानां प्रतिपत्तिश्च सत्या साधुमता सदा ।
सा तु दुःखार्णवं प्राप्य नः स्यादर्चयतां भृशम् ॥

meaning.en: "Reliance on the gods is always true and approved by the good. In this sea of sorrow, may it serve us as we worship them earnestly."

verses.text:
दैवतानि च सर्वाणि पूज्यन्तां भूरिदक्षिणैः ।
अग्नयश्चापि हूयन्तां दाशार्णप्रतिषेधने ॥

meaning.en: "Let all the gods be honored with abundant gifts, and let the sacred fires be fed with offerings to keep off the Dasharna king."

verses.text:
अयुद्धेन निवृत्तिं च मनसा चिन्तयाभिभो ।
देवतानां प्रसादेन सर्वमेतद्भविष्यति ॥

meaning.en: "Think in your mind, lord, of a way to avoid war; by the grace of the gods all this will come right."

verses.text:
मन्त्रिभिर्मन्त्रितं सार्धं त्वया यत्पृथुलोचन ।
पुरस्यास्याविनाशाय तच्च राजंस्तथा कुरु ॥

meaning.en: "Whatever you have planned with your ministers, broad-eyed king, for saving this city, do that."

verses.text:
दैवं हि मानुषोपेतं भृशं सिध्यति पार्थिव ।
परस्परविरोधात्तु नानयोः सिद्धिरस्ति वै ॥

meaning.en: "For destiny joined with human effort succeeds well, O king; but when they oppose each other, neither of the two succeeds."

verses.text:
तस्माद्विधाय नगरे विधानं सचिवैः सह ।
अर्चयस्व यथाकामं दैवतानि विशां पते ॥

meaning.en: "So make your arrangements in the city with your ministers, and honor the gods as you wish, O lord of men."

verses.text:
एवं संभाषमाणौ तौ दृष्ट्वा शोकपरायणौ ।
शिखण्डिनी तदा कन्या व्रीडितेव मनस्विनी ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the two of them talking so, sunk in grief, the maiden Shikhandini, high-minded, felt ashamed.

verses.text:
ततः सा चिन्तयामास मत्कृते दुःखितावुभौ ।
इमाविति ततश्चक्रे मतिं प्राणविनाशने ॥

meaning.en: Then she thought, "These two are unhappy because of me," and she resolved to end her life.

verses.text:
एवं सा निश्चयं कृत्वा भृशं शोकपरायणा ।
जगाम भवनं त्यक्त्वा गहनं निर्जनं वनम् ॥

meaning.en: Having made that resolve and overcome by sorrow, she left the house and went to a dense, lonely forest.

verses.text:
यक्षेणर्द्धिमता राजन्स्थूणाकर्णेन पालितम् ।
तद्भयादेव च जनो विसर्जयति तद्वनम् ॥

meaning.en: That forest was guarded by a powerful yaksha, Sthunakarna, and for fear of him people avoid it.

verses.text:
तत्र स्थूणस्य भवनं सुधामृत्तिकलेपनम् ।
लाजोल्लापिकधूमाढ्यमुच्चप्राकारतोरणम् ॥

meaning.en: In it stood Sthuna's mansion, plastered with lime and clay, filled with the smoke of parched grain offerings, with high walls and gateways.

verses.text:
तत्प्रविश्य शिखण्डी सा द्रुपदस्यात्मजा नृप ।
अनश्नती बहुतिथं शरीरमुपशोषयत् ॥

meaning.en: Entering it, Shikhandini, Drupada's child, O king, dried up her body, going without food for many days.

verses.text:
दर्शयामास तां यक्षः स्थूणो मध्वक्षसंयुतः ।
किमर्थोऽयं तवारम्भः करिष्ये ब्रूहि माचिरम् ॥

meaning.en: The yaksha Sthuna appeared to her, sweet-eyed, and said, "What is the purpose of this undertaking of yours? Tell me, and I will do it at once."

verses.text:
अशक्यमिति सा यक्षं पुनः पुनरुवाच ह ।
करिष्यामीति चैनां स प्रत्युवाचाथ गुह्यकः ॥

meaning.en: "It cannot be done," she said to the yaksha again and again; but the Guhyaka answered her, "I will do it."

verses.text:
धनेश्वरस्यानुचरो वरदोऽस्मि नृपात्मजे ।
अदेयमपि दास्यामि ब्रूहि यत्ते विवक्षितम् ॥

meaning.en: "I am a servant of the lord of wealth, Kubera, and a giver of boons, king's daughter. I will give even what ought not to be given; tell me what you wish to say."

verses.text:
ततः शिखण्डी तत्सर्वमखिलेन न्यवेदयत् ।
तस्मै यक्षप्रधानाय स्थूणाकर्णाय भारत ॥

meaning.en: Then Shikhandini told that chief of yakshas, Sthunakarna, everything in full, O Bharata.

verses.text:
आपन्नो मे पिता यक्ष नचिराद्विनशिष्यति ।
अभियास्यति संक्रुद्धो दशार्णाधिपतिर्हि तम् ॥

meaning.en: "My father is in trouble, yaksha, and will soon perish; the king of the Dasharnas, in a rage, will march against him."

verses.text:
महाबलो महोत्साहः स हेमकवचो नृपः ।
तस्माद्रक्षस्व मां यक्ष पितरं मातरं च मे ॥

meaning.en: "That king is mighty and full of energy, and wears golden armor. So protect me, yaksha, and my father and mother."

verses.text:
प्रतिज्ञातो हि भवता दुःखप्रतिनयो मम ।
भवेयं पुरुषो यक्ष त्वत्प्रसादादनिन्दितः ॥

meaning.en: "You have promised to remove my distress. Let me become a man by your grace, yaksha, without reproach."

verses.text:
यावदेव स राजा वै नोपयाति पुरं मम ।
तावदेव महायक्ष प्रसादं कुरु गुह्यक ॥

meaning.en: "Until that king reaches my city, O great yaksha, show me your favor, Guhyaka."
